svg.aria-label: The three cases of the circle criterion. Left, 0 < alpha < beta: the Nyquist plot must stay outside the disk D(alpha, beta) through −1/alpha and −1/beta, and encircle it as many times anticlockwise as G has unstable poles. Middle, alpha = 0: the plot must lie to the right of the vertical line Re = −1/beta. Right, alpha < 0 < beta: the plot must lie inside the disk
svg.title: The three cases of the circle criterion. Left, 0 < alpha < beta: the Nyquist plot must stay outside the disk D(alpha, beta) through −1/alpha and −1/beta, and encircle it as many times anticlockwise as G has unstable poles. Middle, alpha = 0: the plot must lie to the right of the vertical line Re = −1/beta. Right, alpha < 0 < beta: the plot must lie inside the disk

g.text: α = 0 < β: right of the line
blue: Nyquist plot of G(jω); pink: forbidden region
